text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, Sept 3 - Bombay - Delays expected for vessels due - container vessels 3-4 days, bulk 6-7 days, general cargo 14-15 days. 6 vessels loading at berth, 27 discharging at berth, 4 discharging at anchorage, 10 waiting to load, 31 waiting to discharge. 1 vessel bunkering, 5 under repair, 2 awaiting orders. Occasional rain has hampered cargo operation.

Calcutta - 16 vessels due of which 1 coke, 5 coal, 7 product tankers, 2 containers. 6 loading at berth, 10 discharging at berth, 1 bunkering. Cochin - vessels due - 2 containers with up to 1 days delay, 1 fertiliser, up to 1 day's delay, general cargo up to 1 day's delay. Scrap depending on receivers readiness to receive direct delivery. No delays for tankers. 2 vessels under repair/drydock. Mormugao - Delays - molasses 1 day, petroleum 1-2 days, containers 1 day. 2 vessels loading at berth, 1 loading at anchorage, 1 discharging at berth, 1 waiting to discharge. 5 under repair/drydock, 1 awaiting orders.

Jawaharlal Nehru - Five vessels due. 4 tankers/iron ore vessels, 5-6 days delay. 2 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 to discharge. Kandla - nine vessels due, 7-8 days delay expected. 3 loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 9 waiting at anchorage to load, 4 waiting to discharge. 3 tankers. 24 vessels waiting. Mangalore - Four iron ore concentrate pellets due, 1-2 days delay. Up to 1 days delay for granite blocks, molasses, timber, woodpulp, crude, chemicals, general cargo. 4 loading at berth, 2 discharging, 1 waiting.

Madras - 35 vessels due by 9/9 with following berthing delays - coal/coke 4-5 days, fertiliser 3-4 days, scrap 5-6 days, others 3-4 days. 5 vessels loading at berth, 14 discharging at berth, 16 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Tuticorin - Two vessels due with 1-2 days berthing delay. 3 loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge.

Visakhapatnam - Up to 1 day's delay for iron ore, laden containers, general cargo, alumina, urea, caustic soda. 7-8 days delay plates, steel billets/coils, chrome, magnesite, rock phosphate, 2-3 days delay vegetable oil. 4 vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load at inner harbour berth, 5 waiting to discharge.

Paradip - vessels due - 3 coal, 2 chrome, 3-4 days delay, 2 iron with 2-3 days delay, 1 general, 4-5 days delay. Fertiliser 10-12 days delay, oil 2-3 days delay, food 2-3 days delay, scrap 15-16 days delay. 2 vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 to discharge.

PAKISTAN, Sept 2 - Karachi - 2 loading at berth (1 general cargo, 1 rice). 9 discharging at berth (logs, urea, DAP, scrap, MEP, sugar, general cargo, MTB/MEG). 3 container vessels loading/discharging. 1 sugar vessel waiting at anchorage to discharge. 1 awaiting orders, 3 due, up to 24 hours delay.

PHILIPPINES, Sept 3 - Manila - 15 vessels discharging at berth, 12 vessels discharging at anchorage, 2 vessels waiting at outside anchorage to discharge. 4 other vessels withholding orders. Average waiting time for vessels with a draft less than 8 metres and LOA less than 130 metres is 1 day, for a draft greater than 9 metres and an LOA greater than 140 metres it is 2 days. Occasional monsoon rains.

SINGAPORE, Sept 3 - Tanjong Pagar container terminal - 7 container vessels berthed. Keppel - 11 container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang - 13 container/general cargo berthed. Sembawang - 3 general cargo vessels berthed. Jurong - 2 bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessels berthed. Oil terminal - 20 tankers berthed. Minimum berthing delays at all facilities.

SOUTH KOREA, Sept 3 - Inchon - 119 vessels in port (53 berthed, 66 anchored) of which 6 logs, 6 general cargo, 5 each steel, containers, 4 coils, 3 each wheat blending pellets, 2 each tapioca, copra, cars, plywood, scrap, sugar, 1 each pulp, rice, rapeseed meal, soda, cottonseed meal, H-beam, corn, soybean meal, fertiliser, salt, soybean, wheat. Anchored, 9 logs, 7 general cargo, 6 each scrap, cars, 5 containers, 4 each coils, corn, steel, 2 each rape blending pellets, pig iron, plywood, rice, 1 each cottonseed meal, tapioca, soda, rapeseed meal, steel plates, Busan - 187 in port (53 berthed, 134 anchored including 68 laid up) of which 37 general cargo, 8 container vessels, 4 each scrap, coal. 66 awaiting berth, approx 3 days delay expected. Pohang - 30 vessels in port (22 berthed, 8 anchored) of which discharging, 2 plates, 1 each iron ore, ferro silicone, pipes, logs, wire rods, slabs, scrap, billets. 12 loading steel. 8 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 2 days delay expected.

Ulsan - 29 vessels in port (25 berthed, 4 anchored) of which discharging - 3 feedmeal, 2 soda ash, 1 each logs, ammonia, mono ethyl glycol, alcohol, raw sugar, chemicals, zinc concentrates, copper concentrates, woodchip, crude oil, wheat. Loading, 4 general cargo, 1 each dimethyl formamid chemicals, solvent, fuel oil, diesel oil. 4 awaiting berth with approx 4 days delay. Masan - Three vessels berthed of which discharging, 1 log, 1 steel slabs. 1 Container vessel loading. No berthing delays.

SRI LANKA, Sept 3 - Colombo - eight vessels due, 3-4 days delay. Vessels loading at berth - 5 breakbulk, 11 containers. Discharging at berth 8 breakbulk, 1 bulk tallow, 1 bulk fertiliser, 11 containers. 2 general cargo vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 6 containers, 1 rice, 1 cement, 1 sugar, 1 general waiting to discharge. 3 vessels outside harbour for bunkers, 7 under repairs/drydock, 5 awaiting orders.
Galle - one vessel discharging at berth. Trincomalee - one loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth.

TAIWAN, Aug 31 - Keelung - Three vessels anchored. Berthing delays, coal 5 days, steel/iron ore 3 days. No delays for grain. Kaohsiung - Two vessels anchored. Berthing delays grain/steel 1 day, coal/scrap 1 day (public berth), iron/coal 2 days (CSC berth). Taichung - Seven anchored. Berthing delays, grain 3-4 days, iron ore/coal/steel/others 1-2 days. No delays for scrap.

Sept 2 - Kaohsiung - 69 vessels in port of which 14 containers, 7 tankers, 2 grain, 2 other bulkers, 34 general cargo, 10 at buoys. No vessels waiting at outer anchorage, no delays. Keelung - 29 in port of which 14 container 2 tankers, 9 other bulkers, 4 general cargo. 4 Container vessels waiting at outer anchorage with 16 hours average berthing delay expected.
